The MediaWiki provides a way to tag articles (at the end of the article). We are using this feature to structure the Wiki.

### Ecosystem tags

Elements of the Nix Ecosystem should be tagged by one or more of the following categories:

<a href=":Category:NixOS" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:NixOS]]"><code>[[Category:NixOS]]</code></a>  
Articles related to the Nix operating system, the module system and the system configuration.

<a href=":Category:Nix" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Nix]]"><code>[[Category:Nix]]</code></a>  
Articles about using the Nix Tools to accomplish great things.

<a href=":Category:Nixpkgs" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Nixpkgs]]"><code>[[Category:Nixpkgs]]</code></a>  
Articles about maintaining code in the Nixpkgs repository, structuring, and so on.

<a href=":Category:Nix_Language" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Nix Language]]"><code>[[Category:Nix Language]]</code></a>  
Description of language quirks and solutions.

<a href=":Category:Hydra" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Hydra]]"><code>[[Category:Hydra]]</code></a>  
Articles about Hydra continuous Integration related documentation.

<a href=":Category:Application" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Application]]"><code>[[Category:Application]]</code></a>  
Extended Ecosystem: Articles about other Nix-based or Nix-related applications.

### Topic tags

Almost all content of the wiki can be accessed with 2 to 3 clicks via one of these topic categories:

<a href=":Category:Software" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Software]]"><code>[[Category:Software]]</code></a>  
Articles about software applications like neovim or libreoffice

<a href=":Category:Hardware" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Hardware]]"><code>[[Category:Hardware]]</code></a>  
Articles about hardware like GPU, keyboards and notebooks.

<a href=":Category:Desktop" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Desktop]]"><code>[[Category:Desktop]]</code></a>  
Articles about using NixOS on a PC (e.g. desktop environments)

<a href=":Category:Server" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Server]]"><code>[[Category:Server]]</code></a>  
Articles about using NixOS on servers, like running web applications (e.g. Nextcloud)

<a href=":Category:Community" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Community]]"><code>[[Category:Community]]</code></a>  
Articles about the Nix(OS) community and how to engage and contribute.

### Resource tags

The [type of documentation](https://www.divio.com/en/blog/documentation/) for new pages should be tagged with one of the following categories:

<a href=":Category:Tutorial" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Tutorial]]"><code>[[Category:Tutorial]]</code></a>  
- is learning-oriented
- allows the newcomer to get started
- is a lesson

<a href=":Category:Discussion" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Discussion]]"><code>[[Category:Discussion]]</code></a>  
- is understanding-oriented
- explains
- provides background and context

<a href=":Category:Guide" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Guide]]"><code>[[Category:Guide]]</code></a>  
- is goal-oriented
- how-to's for dealing with a specific problem / tool
- is a series of steps

<a href=":Category:Cookbook" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Cookbook]]"><code>[[Category:Cookbook]]</code></a>  
- is recipe orientated
- a collection of short code snippets and hacks
- arranged around a theme or tool

<a href=":Category:Reference" class="wikilink" title="[[Category:Reference]]"><code>[[Category:Reference]]</code></a>  
- is information-oriented
- describes the machinery
- is accurate and complete
- Most of the time the NixOS Wiki will not contain reference documents
